description: Budget management platform for service businesses. This file is the durable feature queue for the multi-agent harness.

features.name: budget_authorization_contracts
features.title: Harden budget ownership and category authorization
features.description: Refactor budgets and budget categories so reads and mutations enforce authenticated ownership or admin contracts before later UI work.
acceptance: getBudgets, getBudgetBySlug, getBudgetById, duplicate, update, and delete only expose or mutate budgets owned by the authenticated user
Budget mutations call auth() first, validate input with schemas, verify ownership before writing, and return consistent { error } results
BudgetCategory actions are explicitly admin-only through requireAdminSession() or converted to a documented user-owned model
Budget create/update/delete flows have no debug console.log statements
Manual smoke covers budget list, detail, create, edit, duplicate, delete, and budget categories

features.name: platform_dependency_patch_review
features.title: Review and patch Next and React dependencies
features.description: Run a controlled platform upgrade for Next.js, React, and React DOM to patched compatible versions.
acceptance: Next.js, React, and React DOM target versions are checked against the current patched release line before editing package files
package.json and the lockfile are updated together with no unrelated dependency churn
Any migration notes or breaking changes are documented in progress/current.md or a feature report
Verification includes init.ps1 and pnpm build when environment variables permit
Manual smoke covers auth, dashboard navigation, and AI chat after the upgrade

features.name: ops_occurrence_scheduling_refactor
features.title: Separate ops occurrence reads, generation, and scheduling UI
features.description: Make job occurrence reads and generation commands explicit, split the occurrence dialog and scheduling helpers by responsibility, and improve measured Visits loading under the current infrastructure.
acceptance: getJobOccurrences is strictly read-only and occurrence generation or persistence is moved behind an explicitly named idempotent command
Occurrence generation, persistence, employees, and recurrence math have clear module ownership
JobOccurrenceDialog is split into dialog shell, form, form state, and submit helpers where useful
Jobs and employees required by JobOccurrenceDialog load on demand instead of during every Visits page load

Three equivalent authenticated Visits loads are measured under the same infrastructure and the main-content median is at most 4 seconds, or the remaining external bottleneck is documented with evidence
Scheduling-related authored files stay under 200 lines unless an exception is explicitly justified
Manual smoke covers monthly calendar load, create visit, edit visit, split occurrence, and archive flows

features.name: ops_visits_mobile_controls_compaction
features.title: Compact Visits controls and cards on mobile
features.description: Keep the monthly selector usable above Visits, move the remaining mobile filters into a bottom sheet, and compact visit summaries without changing operational behavior.
acceptance: The monthly selector remains visible above Visits and fits one 390-pixel-wide row without horizontal overflow
Mobile Visits shows the result count and active chips outside a shadcn bottom sheet containing the contextual filters, clear-all, and close actions
Desktop keeps the expanded filter fields and existing monthly selector presentation
Exact-date filtering remains available only in List and Cards views and all filters continue to apply immediately
Visits, Realizadas, and Pendientes render as one compact horizontal mobile row while larger breakpoints keep the current metric cards
Calendar agenda cards show the planned time once and strengthen the employee label without changing its color
Harness, lint, and authenticated 390x844 plus desktop browser smoke are recorded

features.name: job_form_dialog_trigger_fix
features.title: Restore job form dialog triggers
features.description: Fix the shared job form trigger so create and edit buttons open their dialog again.
acceptance: Nuevo trabajo opens the job form dialog from the Jobs page
Editar and Editar trabajo open the populated job form dialog from list and detail surfaces
The shared trigger forwards Radix dialog event, accessibility, and ref props to the underlying button
Focused browser smoke and lint pass without changing job persistence contracts

features.name: ops_employee_accruals_view
features.title: Accumulated aguinaldo and vacation salary view
features.description: Add an employees view listing accumulated aguinaldo and vacation salary per employee for a period, with the team total.
acceptance: The Empleados page exposes a button that opens the accruals view
The view lists every employee with hours in the period and their generated aguinaldo, vacation salary, and combined total
The view shows the summed team totals and flags employees without an hourly rate
The period is a date range with current year and aguinaldo semester presets, shareable through start and end search params
Focused accrual checks, TypeScript, lint, harness, and a production build pass

features.name: ops_weekly_schedules
features.title: Weekly schedule board inside Visits with Bambu PDF
features.description: Add a Monday-to-Sunday schedule view to /dashboard/calendar for planning a whole week per employee: multi-employee filter, hideable weekdays, pointer drag to move a visit to another day, inline create and edit through the visit dialog, a separate schedule-facing name for jobs and visits, downloadable PDFs with the Bambu logo per employee and for the team, subtle warnings when two visits of the same employee cross, drag to another employee row or free slot to change day, hour and team, a free-slot finder for new services, and per-employee availability rules so the finder does not offer false gaps.
acceptance: Visitas exposes a Cronograma view alongside Calendario, Lista and Tarjetas instead of a separate route
The week runs Monday to Sunday in America/Montevideo and moves with previous, next and current week controls that stop at the occurrence generation horizon
A searchable multi-select filters the board by employees and weekday chips hide Saturday or Sunday, with the choice remembered
Dragging a visit to another day preserves its local time and day span and persists through the existing occurrence update contract
Clicking a visit opens the existing dialog to edit or delete it, and each day cell can create a visit prefilled with that date and employee
Jobs carry a schedule name and visits can override it, so the employee sees a different label than the internal job name
The employee selector in the visit dialog searches like the job filter in Visitas
Each employee row downloads its own PDF and the team PDF bundles everyone, both honouring the hidden weekdays
Two visits of the same employee that cross in time warn subtly on the card, the employee row and the toolbar without blocking the overlap
Dragging a visit to another employee row moves day, hour and team in one update, keeping the rest of the team on the visit
Dropping on a free slot inside a day cell sets the start hour and keeps the duration of the visit
The board finds free slots for a chosen service duration and creates a visit prefilled with that employee, day and hour
Each employee can declare the hours or days she cannot take services, and those tramos are excluded from the free slots and flag the visits that fall there
Focused schedule, availability and schedule PDF checks, TypeScript, lint, harness and a production build pass

features.name: ops_finance_searchable_tables
features.title: Searchable tables for Finance receivables, costs, and payroll
features.description: Replace the card lists and nested scroll boxes of Cobros, Costes, and Pagos in /dashboard/financial with compact sortable, paginated tables and one accent-insensitive search per section, while job detail, employee detail, and the legacy routes keep their current lists.
acceptance: Cobros, Costes, and Pagos render compact tables with sortable headers exposing aria-sort, 25-row pagination, and a count and recorded-total footer, without nested scroll containers

Each section has one case- and accent-insensitive search beside its existing filters that matches names, references, notes, and raw or formatted amounts, and Limpiar clears it together with the filters

Cobros switches between Cobros and Generado por empleada and Pagos between Por empleada and Pagos registrados through a view control synchronized with ?vista=, and Resumen's Ver todo opens Generado por empleada

Rows keep edit, void confirmation, register payment with the suggested balance, and period summary actions, return focus to the button that opened a dialog, and show the per-employee accrual breakdown in an expandable row
At 390 pixels the amount and actions fold into the first cell with 44-pixel targets and no horizontal overflow
Financial calculations, KPIs, permissions, and persistence contracts do not change, and shared dialogs, filters, and summaries stay backward compatible for their other callers
check:finance-tables, the existing finance checks, TypeScript, lint, harness, a production build, and authenticated desktop plus 390-pixel browser smoke are recorded

features.name: ops_payroll_paid_in_arrears
features.title: Payroll balance settles the previous month's hours
features.description: Salaries are paid in arrears: employee payments stay counted in the month they are made, while the payroll suggested amount, accruals, and balance compare them against the hours worked the month before in Finance, /dashboard/payroll, and the employee payroll panel.
acceptance: Employee payments keep counting in their assigned month for Resumen, trend, costs, and the PDF export

Finance Pagos, /dashboard/payroll, and the employee payroll panel compute hours, suggested amount, accruals, and balance from the previous month's completed visits against the selected month's payments
Registrar pago defaults the assigned month to the selected month and the worked period to the previous month
Each payroll screen states which month's hours it is settling
check:finance covers the previous-month rule including the year boundary, plus TypeScript, lint, harness, and authenticated browser smoke

features.name: agent_budget_editor
features.title: Edit agent budgets in a sheet and save them to the generator
features.description: Calculation cards and create-budget proposals open a sheet with the generator form and the live budget detail. Saving creates the generator budget through a CREATE_BUDGET proposal tied to that tool call (new for a calculation, the pending one revised for a proposal) confirmed in the same action, so it is audited and the agent sees it. Tool outputs carry the full values for the UI and hide them from the model. See docs/agent-plan.md.
acceptance: Calculation cards and create-budget proposal cards offer Ver detalle and Editar, which open a sheet over the chat, also over the budget sheet, with the budget detail and the generator form
The detail shows the without- and with-products breakdown of the budget page and recalculates live as the form changes
Guardar en el generador validates the name and values with Spanish messages, reports a taken slug on the name field, and creates the budget with the edited values

Saving goes through a CREATE_BUDGET proposal tied to that tool call, new for a calculation and the pending one revised for a proposal, confirmed in the same action: idempotent, audited, and listed for the agent in later turns
After saving, the card and the sheet show the saved budget with links to open and edit it in the generator, and a saved or executing budget is read-only
calculateBudget, solveForTargetPrice, and proposeCreateBudget return the full values for the UI while the model receives the output without them, and older outputs fall back to their inputs
Unsaved edits survive closing and reopening the sheet during the session and the card says so
Focused checks, TypeScript, lint, build, and authenticated browser smoke on desktop and 390x844 pass

features.name: security_dependency_patch
features.title: Patch high-severity dependency vulnerabilities
features.description: pnpm audit reports 32 high advisories (22 in production dependencies). Patch direct dependencies and force fixed transitive versions without breaking the mail agent, Excel export, Prisma, or the build.
acceptance: pnpm audit --prod reports no high or critical advisories; any remaining exception is documented with its reason in the progress report

Direct dependencies move to fixed versions: nodemailer >=9.1.1, postcss >=8.5.23, and resend on its latest stable release; uuid is removed in favor of crypto.randomUUID() (user decision 2026-09-28); the optional next-auth nodemailer peer warning is documented as harmless because the Auth.js email provider is not used

Transitive advisories (minimatch, brace-expansion through exceljs>archiver, nanoid, browserslist, picomatch, flatted, js-yaml, and effect/defu/deepmerge-ts through prisma) are fixed by upgrading their parents or with scoped pnpm overrides
The pnpm minimum-release-age policy is respected and the lockfile diff only contains the intended upgrades
Verification includes TypeScript, lint, every check:* script (especially check:mail-agent and check:job-export), pnpm build, and an authenticated smoke of the mail inbox and job Excel export

features.name: payroll_data_gaps
features.title: Fix July and August payroll data gaps
features.description: Production payroll data predates the paid-in-arrears rules: July has 141 DONE visits without actual times, so August shows a -99.524 balance, and August payments are recorded with an 1-31 August period although they pay July. This is a data task on the production database.
acceptance: A read-only report lists the July DONE visits without actual times and the August payments with their current periods before any write
The user decides the correction rule for visits and payment periods before any script is written
The correction runs as a script with a dry-run preview and only writes after explicit user permission
After the write, the August balance is recalculated read-only and matches the value the user expects
No other visits, payments, employees, or months change; the progress report records counts before and after

features.name: agent_test_data_cleanup
features.title: Delete agent test data from production
features.description: Remove the test budgets and agent conversations created while verifying the agent budget editor, agent page, and pricing rules. This is a data task on the production database.
acceptance: A read-only query lists the test budgets ("Prueba agente 43 cálculo", "Prueba agente 43 propuesta", "Prueba 43 aporte vacío", "Prueba 43 propuesta editada", "Prueba 43 confirmar con borrador") and the agent page and pricing test conversations with ids and dates
The user reviews the list and explicitly approves the deletion
Only the approved records and their dependent rows are deleted
A second read-only query confirms they are gone and that no other budget or conversation changed

features.name: budget_query_cache
features.title: Centralize budget cache keys and fix stale list updates
features.description: Budget and category query keys are hard-coded across 15 files, and create, update, and duplicate read queryKey[1].query, which is always undefined, so cache updates hit every cached list and search invalidation never matches.
acceptance: A budget and budget-category query key factory with invalidation helpers exists, following components/ops/query-keys.ts
Budget hooks, category hooks, official-budget mutations, agent proposal mutations, and the agent budget save hook use the factory instead of literal keys
Create, update, and duplicate update or invalidate only the lists they affect; the queryKey[1].query bug is gone
Duplicate and delete invalidate budget lists, delete removes the cached budget detail, and category mutations invalidate category details and budget lists
Budget mutations invalidate the operations job budget sources cache
Source checks that assert literal budget keys (agent-budget-editor-source-checks, agent-sheet-source-checks, check-official-budget-workspace) are updated
Manual smoke covers create, edit, duplicate, delete, and category edits with filtered and unfiltered lists

features.name: runtime_sdk_cleanup
features.title: Lazy initialize Resend, retire Cloudinary, and clean debug debt
features.description: lib/mail.ts creates the Resend client and reads NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL at module scope, Cloudinary is configured in an unused module while profile uploads are disabled, and a few user-data and budget wrapper paths keep debug logging or wrong messages.
acceptance: Resend is created through a lazy getter and the base URL is read when an email is sent; both fail with clear errors when missing
Cloudinary is removed: lib/cloudinary.ts, the cloudinary dependency, CLOUDINARY_* in .env.template, and the res.cloudinary.com image pattern
updateProfileImage returns an explicit error instead of a success message while uploads are disabled, and check-settings-auth is updated
data/user.ts no longer uses console.log or swallows errors silently
Budget category wrappers use correct export names and messages, and get-budgets uses a Spanish fallback message
Verification includes init.ps1, pnpm build, and a smoke of register, password reset, and two-factor emails

features.name: ops_es_uy_locale
features.title: Localize operations dates and calendar to es-UY
features.description: Operations text formatters already use es-UY, but the document is lang=en and the calendar shows English month and weekday names with weeks starting on Sunday.
acceptance: The root layout declares lang=es-UY
The shared Calendar uses the Spanish date-fns locale, Monday week start, and Spanish month labels instead of the default locale
Visits selects today by default in the current month and the first visible day only for another month; the Generate visits day-based preset follows that selected day
Desktop and 390x844 browser smoke confirms no English month, weekday, or date labels in operations

features.name: ops_visits_guided_intents
features.title: Split visit scheduling and completion intents
features.description: The visit sheet and dialog, shared form, and mobile filter sheet are already in place. What remains is presenting Cards as Tarjetas, replacing the completeOnSave flag with explicit intents, and surfacing calendar load errors.
acceptance: Calendar remains the initial Visits view and the Cards view is labeled Tarjetas while the stored view value stays cards
JobOccurrenceDialog exposes explicit schedule and complete intents instead of completeOnSave, persisting through the existing occurrence contracts
Every caller passes an intent: agenda, visit list, job occurrences panel, pending panel, and schedule board (schedule)
The on-open loading asserted by check-occurrence-generation is preserved and check-occurrence-dialog is updated for the intent API
The calendar agenda shows a retryable error instead of an empty day when its query fails
Loading, error, retry, empty, keyboard, desktop, and 390x844 authenticated browser states are verified

features.name: ops_contextual_period
features.title: Show the month control only where it changes data
features.description: The operations layout renders one global month selector on every route, including pages with their own ranges, and Visits duplicates month navigation with the calendar arrows.
acceptance: An OpsPeriodControl replaces the always-rendered global selector and appears only on Visits month views, Finance, Jobs profitability, and the employee payroll section
The employee list, accruals, weekly schedule, email, and job occurrences routes do not show a month control
Visits keeps the top month control and removes the calendar's own month arrows
The selected month is synchronized with the URL, with localStorage only as a fallback
The period used by Jobs profitability is decided with the user and recorded in the progress report
Desktop and 390x844 browser smoke confirms no duplicated controls or overflow

features.name: budget_form_sections
features.title: Split the budget form into a shared shell and sections
features.description: CreateBudgetForm is 493 lines while edit already uses sections, create and edit duplicate layout and price-sync logic, option building is copied between actions, and the budget list and create pages are full client pages.
acceptance: Create and edit share a BudgetFormShell and the existing section components; CreateBudgetForm no longer holds the sections inline
The agent budget sheet can still mount the create form with only a form context, and its source checks are updated
Price sync, auto-calculate handlers, and the section card are shared instead of duplicated
Slug, unique slug, option row building, and option-to-form mapping live under lib/budgets
One helper parses and serializes budget list filters for the page and filter components, and pagination lives in the URL
The budget list and create pages are no longer full-page client components; remaining client-heavy views are documented in the progress report
Unused BudgetDetail and BudgetPreviewWrapper are deleted and every authored budget form file stays at 200 lines or less
Manual smoke covers create, edit, duplicate, delete, category selection, preview, filtering, and the agent sheet Editar tab

features.name: ops_coordination_lists
features.title: Turn jobs and employees into coordination-first lists
features.description: Make Jobs and Employees faster to scan by prioritizing the next operational action, shared query state, responsive density, and explicit failures.
acceptance: Jobs and Employees share an OpsQueryState contract built on the Finance table state helpers for search, filters, active chips, URL behavior, and clear state
Search feedback begins after approximately 350 milliseconds instead of 500
Desktop uses compact scannable rows and mobile uses compact cards without horizontal overflow
Jobs prioritize next occurrence, team coverage, attention, and profitability while Employees prioritize status, next assignment, and contact details
Each record exposes one primary action and moves secondary actions into the existing OpsActionMenu; job editing opens a controlled JobFormDialog
The jobs list DTO provides nextOccurrence and activeAssignmentCount without per-row queries
Loading, retryable error, true empty, filtered empty, lint, build when available, and authenticated responsive browser smoke are recorded
